native_flow: SendInitialPacket emits discriminator1, component restart flag, third flag0, timestamp0+zero cookie, terminator1.
Native connectionless receiver consumes optional MagicHeader prefix and discriminator, parser requires remaining194bits (ordinary) or354bits (extended), then reads booleans/float32/cookie(s).
Native server challenge uses driver timestamp+220, component third flag+50 and20-byte generated cookie; native client positive timestamp branch echoes using SendChallengeResponse.
Native ACK writes restart0, third flag1, float32 -1,20-byte authorized cookie and terminator1.
Normal native client negative ACK initializes14-bit sequences from cookie words0/1, stores authorized cookie, completes handshake. Restart ACK skips sequence/cookie replacement branch.

handler_framing.terminator: If component count>0, final byte must be nonzero; highest set bit is excluded with higher zero padding. Remaining bits feed FBitReader.
handler_framing.stateless_dispatch: Connected vslot18 or connectionless vslot30 using actual constructor-backed Stateless vtable.
handler_framing.handshake_writers_direct_send: Writers already append their own terminator and set Handler+290 bypass flag while invoking connection vslot288 or driver vslot300. No ordinary outgoing zero discriminator should be prepended again.
handler_framing.ordinary_data: Stateless Outgoing prepends configured MagicHeader bits then discriminator0 to an ordinary packet; this is a distinct path from handshake direct send.
